subject: 清初至清中北方衙署院落（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE isolated production building sprite for tianshu default city-map. Asset bld_kit_qing_north_yamen, early-to-mid Qing northern China, generic county government compound, footprint17m east-west x13m north-south. Northern gray brick courtyard enclosure, dark gray tile roofs with modest hard gables and official front hall, three-bay main hall at rear, small side rooms, modest dark-red painted gate and pillars, very restrained blue-green painted beam trim, central stone court and a court drum. No yellow glazed tiles, no imperial dragons. South gate faces SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Camera ORTHOGRAPHIC yaw45 elevation30, exact 2:1 dimetric ground: front-left-to-front-corner edge slope+0.5, front-corner-to-right edge slope-0.5; keep both axes parallel, ground axis length ratio17:13. Thin flat rectangular ground footprint with left, front and right base corners unambiguously readable. NOT a thick diorama plinth. Realistic historical architectural sprite, hand-finished soft weathering, warm-neutral gray masonry and realistic small tiles, same detail density as supplied Song kit reference. Supplied image is only material/rendering/projection reference; replace pale Song plaster/timber with Qing northern gray brick and restrained official paint. Fully complete asset surrounded by at least10% transparent margin. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, no environment or checkerboard. Light SCREEN UPPER LEFT; tiny soft contact shadow SCREEN LOWER RIGHT. No text of any kind, no signboards, logos, characters, people, flags with symbols, modern objects, landscape, sky, horizon, roads, external trees, oversized curling eaves, perspective convergence or clipping. Original game interpretation, not a named historical monument. The 2:1 ratio describes the ground projection, not the canvas. Correction for candidate 2: Match the supplied image's camera and size of base exactly: the rectangular foundation must have corners LEFT(220,570), FRONT(900,910), RIGHT(1420,650) on a1536x1024 canvas. Ground edge slopes exactly+0.5 and-0.5, axis lengths17:13. Make the compound fit this outline. No exterior vegetation. CRITICAL: Absolutely no surrounding smoke, glow, mist, ambient halo or broad shadow. Surrounding pixels entirely transparent, confined 5-pixel contact shadow beneath the base only. Do not reproduce black/colored reference preview background; it is transparent.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚地台、裁切、透视汇聚、黄色帝王琉璃瓦

references.role: 宋套件相机/材质参考；非清代形制证据

created_time_basis: copy2保留的源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端时间

projection_contract.contract_note: 目标契约；实际源图投影误差见geometry_qa，不能据此宣称所有视角合格。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding
processing.anchor_transform_note: 锚点按整数重采样尺寸对应的rounded_effective_scale分别作用于源X/Y；图像仍仅做一次名义等比缩放，差异来自像素取整。

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面三角点，±3px不确定性；底面中心取(L+R)/2。后角为L+R−F推算，非3D测绘；未以变形纠偏。

notes: 已逐张view_image检查源图及浅底alpha合成诊断：主体完整、无文字人物现代物；灰砖灰瓦暗木与宋套件细节密度相近，王府绿瓦和官式红柱区分等级。直接PNG预览的灰棕晕属于透明像素RGB，浅底alpha合成无外部光晕；未改alpha。design/22 §3.4 清初衙署骨架17×13；单体为原创扩展。 双轴/占地比例未全部通过，保留candidate供审校；不得直接当发布资产。 最终PNG已再次逐张view_image自查；历史来源统一见prompts/building-map.md清北节及tools/agents/reports/KIT-qing_north.md §7。
